# 07 — Registry

**Purpose:** Authoritative data sources that record all active entities and their current values. Supporting system — not governance. All registries are generated by the Build System — never hand-authored.

**Scope:** Design Token Registry, Component Registry, Asset Registry, Exception Registry.

**Belongs here (active):**
- `token-registry.json` — Generated design token catalog (143 tokens, 15 categories)
- `asset-registry.json` — Generated asset catalog (18 assets: 15 icons, 3 logos)

**Planned:**
- `component-registry.json` — Registry of all active components
- `exception-registry.json` — Required by Override & Exception Policy §6.1

**Does NOT belong here:** Governance rules, standards, or implementation files.
